summary: Tested iter13 features (harga_channel per e-commerce, transactions date/sort filter, POS no auto-download, Riwayat period/sort filters + bulk delete). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed. Frontend: all data-testids present and working for Daftar Harga online tab columns, Penjualan Online channel selector + price switching, Riwayat period/sort/bulk-delete flow, admin-only bulk delete (kasir does not see checkboxes). POS auto-download prevention verified by code review (checkout() in POS.jsx does not call printReceipt; it only sets lastInvoice state) and by observing no download event during admin flow. Cangkul Baja Super verified: harga_channel = {Shopee: 99000, Tokopedia: 97000} and both prices show on product cards when switching channel.
critical_code_review_comments: RiwayatTransaksi bulk delete loops client-side DELETE per transaction (N requests). For large selections this is slow and non-atomic. Consider adding POST /api/transactions/bulk-delete endpoint that handles stock restoration + deletion server-side in one call.

server.py list_transactions uses regex ^date on created_at string. OK for YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD because ISO timestamps start with those prefixes, but add an index or at least ensure created_at is always ISO.

PenjualanOnline priceFor falls back to harga_online when channel price is falsy; empty string 0 also falls back which is correct, but Cangkul has harga_online=0 — in production this could show 'Harga online belum diatur' for channels with no override. Acceptable per spec.
server.py has >1600 lines — consider splitting into modules (routers/products.py, routers/transactions.py, etc.) for maintainability.
